Select distinct molecule ChEMBL identifiers and canonical SMILES for compounds tested in assays against the human nuclear receptor ROR-γ (CHEMBL1741186) where the assay organism is human. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then to assays, then to target_dictionary, and finally to compound_structures. Filter by target ChEMBL ID CHEMBL1741186 and assay organism Homo sapiens. Return compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Sort by compound_chembl_id.
